parsed.rationale: The cluster_id explicitly identifies one of the two participating records as residing in 'AnalyticsTesting/MockStructuredAnalytics.swift' under the name 'MockStructuredAnalytics.StoppedEventProxy__Playback'. The 'AnalyticsTesting' path segment and the 'Mock' prefix are canonical mock-fixture markers. Per the decision rules, any cluster where at least one record is a mock fixture must be treated as no-action, because lifting the production type 'PlaybackStoppedEvent' (in 'PlaybackCore/Analytics/PlaybackAnalytics.swift') into shared code alongside a mock proxy would couple production semantics to test/mock infrastructure. The subset relationship between the proxy and the real event type is intentional: the mock deliberately exposes only the subset of fields it needs to intercept for testing.
